🌟 shellfirm | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Preventing dangerous or unintended shell command execution by humans and AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • 100+ patterns across 9 ecosystems • Support for 8 shells (Zsh, Bash, Fish, etc.) • Context-aware escalation (SSH, root, production environments) • Safe alternative command suggestions • Configurable severity levels
📖 Summary: Shellfirm acts as a safety net for terminal commands, protecting against accidental or malicious execution by both humans and AI agents. It intercepts commands, analyzes their potential risk, and can present challenges or suggest safer alternatives before execution.
